description: This file defines the Related controller class for handling related products display in the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It loads related products, processes their data, and prepares the output view.

classes.name: Related
classes.description: Controller class for related products, extends base Controller class and provides the index method to display related products.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that retrieves related products based on product_id, processes their data, and renders the related products view.
